title: API Tester
subtitle: Test REST APIs online
description: Comprehensive REST API testing tool for sending HTTP requests, viewing responses, and debugging APIs. Supports all HTTP methods, headers, query parameters, and request bodies.

features.title: All HTTP Methods
features.description: Support for GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, HEAD, OPTIONS

features.title: Headers Editor
features.description: Add and manage custom headers for your requests

features.title: Query Parameters
features.description: Build query parameters easily with key-value pairs

features.title: Request Body Editor
features.description: Support for JSON, form-data, raw text, and URL-encoded bodies

features.title: Response Viewer
features.description: View formatted responses with syntax highlighting

features.title: Code Generation
features.description: Generate cURL and fetch code for your requests

tips: Note: CORS restrictions may prevent testing some APIs directly from the browser
Use the code generation feature to get cURL commands
Save frequently used requests for quick access
Check response headers for useful information
pros: Intuitive user interface for quick API testing.
Supports a wide range of HTTP methods and request body types.
Built-in features like request history and code generation enhance productivity.
Real-time response viewing with syntax highlighting for better readability.
cons: Browser-based nature means potential CORS restrictions for certain APIs.
Lacks advanced features found in desktop clients like environment variables or scripting capabilities for complex workflows.
No direct support for authentication methods beyond basic headers, requiring manual token insertion.
bestFor: Developers, QA engineers, and technical content creators who need a quick, easy, and comprehensive online tool for testing and debugging REST APIs without installing desktop software. Ideal for rapid prototyping, verifying endpoint functionality, and educational purposes.
technicalVerdict: The API Tester is a robust, web-based utility designed for efficient REST API interaction. Its strength lies in its comprehensive support for HTTP methods, diverse request body formats, and user-friendly interface. While it may not replace full-fledged desktop API clients for complex enterprise scenarios due to CORS limitations and advanced feature omissions (e.g., environment management, pre-request scripts), it excels as a quick, accessible, and highly effective tool for individual endpoint testing, debugging, and educational demonstrations. The code generation feature is a significant value-add for developers looking to integrate API calls into their applications.
